digest.component_or_area: code review dispatch and criteria routing
propositions: Project code-review criteria's applies_to field is stored in the overlay but never validated at load and never read during dispatch, causing glob-gated criteria to always run regardless of changed files.
The dispatch path _activated_code_review_project_criteria filters on criterion_id prefix and executor type only, taking no changed-files argument and never consulting applies_to.
No validator checks applies_to shape (list of strings) at overlay load time, allowing malformed values to silently degrade to always-on behavior rather than failing loudly.
Plan-review already implements applies_to gating correctly via project_trigger_fires and validates both applies_to and applies_at at load, proving the pattern works but is absent in code-review.
Project code-review criteria must be gated on applies_to globs matching the changed-files list, using the same glob matcher and changed-files source that the triggers step uses.
